patterns.message: The service-role client BYPASSES RLS. It may only be imported by app/api/cron/** and actions/member.actions.ts (admin user creation). Add an eslint-disable with a written justification if you believe you need it elsewhere.

no-restricted-properties.message: getSession() decodes the cookie WITHOUT verifying its signature. Use getUser() for every authorisation decision (Basic Security §1.4).
